name: Slack
summary: Deliver an approved recipe result to the Slack channel you choose.

setup.credential_label: Slack delivery approved in your own Hermes setup
setup.recommended_scope: Deliver only to the Slack channel you select, after your approval.
setup.customer_action: In your own setup, connect Slack, choose the destination channel, and approve the first test delivery.

customer_setup.summary: Choose one Slack channel where you want to receive this recipe's result.
steps: Pick the Slack channel that should receive the result.
Connect Slack inside your own Hermes setup and review the destination.
Approve one test delivery before enabling a schedule.
customer_setup.secret_handling: Agent Recipes never asks for, displays, stores, or logs connection secrets. Complete authorization only in your customer-owned runtime.

verification.success_looks_like: One approved test result reaches only the Slack channel you selected.
steps: Confirm the selected Slack channel appears in the plan.
Approve and send one test result.
Confirm it did not reach any other channel.

rollback.scope: Only Slack delivery for this selected recipe.
steps: Remove only this recipe's Slack destination in your own runtime.
Leave unrelated recipes and Slack destinations unchanged.
